industry: Structural biology and drug discovery services
summary: Företag 10 provides structural biology, protein crystallography, fragment screening and drug discovery services to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies. The company supports early-stage drug development through contract research and proprietary scientific platforms.
target_market: Global pharmaceutical and biotechnology research market
strategy_notes: Focuses on providing specialized structural biology and drug discovery services to international life science companies while expanding integrated research capabilities.
technology_notes: Uses protein crystallography, NMR spectroscopy, fragment screening and structure-based drug design technologies to support drug discovery programs.
risk_notes: Dependent on R&D spending within the pharmaceutical sector, competition from global CROs, and continued demand for outsourced drug discovery services.
